question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. 

Loathe
solution: The correct answer is **'Admire'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Loathe**__**:** **To hate somebody/something (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से नफ़रत करना)** __ • **​E.g.__**- From an early age the brothers have **loathed** each other. • __**Admire**__**:** **T****o respect or like somebody/something very much (किसी के प्रति आदर व प्रशंसा का भाव रखना)** __ • **​E.g.__**- I’ve always **admired** her for being such a wonderful mother. Hence, the correct answer is **'Admire'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Detest**__**:** **To hate or not like somebody/something at all (किसी से घृणा करना या किसी को बिलकुल पसंद न करना)** __ • **​E.g.__**- They absolutely **detest** each other. • __**Abhor**__**:** **To hate something very much (अत्‍यधिक घृणा करना)** __ • **​E.g.__**- I **abhor** all forms of racism. • __**Despire**__**: ** An incorrect spelling of **despair**. __ • **Despair**__**: The state of having lost all hope (पूर्ण निराशा)** __ • **​E.g.__**- I felt like giving up in **despair**. 30:Tc9e, The correct answer is **'Above'**.
